# KaraoQ

> KaraoQ turns any gathering into karaoke night. Create a room in your browser,
> guests join from their phones by scanning a QR code or entering a short code,
> everyone searches YouTube and adds songs to one shared queue, and the lyrics
> play on any screen. No downloads, no accounts, free to host and free to join.

Key facts:
- Free to host and free to join. Songs stream from YouTube, so there is nothing to buy, rent, or subscribe to.
- No app or install — runs entirely in the browser on phones, tablets, laptops, and smart TVs.
- No account or sign-up for hosts or guests.
- Guests join by scanning a QR code or entering a short room code.
- Songs come from YouTube (millions of karaoke tracks, instrumentals, and lyric videos).
- Show the lyrics on a TV by casting (AirPlay / Google Cast), an HDMI cable, or a pop-out video window.
- Works for house parties, dorms, team events, bars, and venues.
- Available in English, Japanese, Filipino, Spanish, Korean, Portuguese, German, Indonesian, Czech, and French.

## Guides
- [How to host karaoke at home](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/how-to-host-karaoke-at-home): Run a karaoke night at home with no machine — browser, YouTube, and any screen.
- [How to do karaoke on your TV](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/karaoke-on-your-tv): Per-device walkthrough — smart TV browser, Chromecast, Apple TV, Fire TV Stick, Roku, HDMI — plus the fix for delayed vocals.
- [Free YouTube karaoke](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/free-youtube-karaoke): Use YouTube as an endless free karaoke library — finding the right version, songs with no karaoke track, ads, unplayable videos.
- [Home karaoke setup guide](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/home-karaoke-setup): Five levels from a $0 phone-and-TV night to a mixer, powered speakers and UHF wireless mics — what each costs, what to buy, what to skip.
- [Karaoke for bars and venues](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/karaoke-for-bars-and-venues): Let guests queue from their phones — no KJ, no dedicated machine.
- [Cheap home karaoke setup](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/cheap-home-karaoke-setup): Under $200 — a party speaker with a mic input and wired mics; why a karaoke machine is the wrong buy; the Bluetooth delay trap.
- [Best YouTube karaoke channels](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/best-youtube-karaoke-channels): Sing King, KaraFun, Stingray, Party Tyme, Sing2Piano, CC Karaoke — and how to queue them for a party.
- [Free alternatives to KaraFun, Smule and Singa](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/free-karaoke-app-alternatives): An honest comparison for party karaoke — what each app does well, and where KaraoQ fits.

## What's new
- [A music video screen, your own logo and colors, and a karaoke video swap](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/music-video-screen-and-custom-branding) (2026-10-31): Play the original music video on a second screen in time with the karaoke, put your own logo and colors on every screen, and swap a wrong karaoke version in one tap.
- [Song ideas from today's charts, by country, genre and voice](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/karaoke-song-ideas-from-the-charts) (2026-10-30): Song ideas now open on what's hot in your country today, with genre lists from local charts, voice-range lists in 10 languages, and random picks from any country.
- [The most-sung karaoke songs, from real rooms](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/most-sung-karaoke-songs) (2026-10-22): See the songs people actually sing at karaoke, ranked from real KaraoQ queues and refreshed daily, with lists for individual countries.
- [Run karaoke from a smart TV, no laptop needed](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/karaoke-on-a-smart-tv-without-a-laptop) (2026-09-24): Open KaraoQ in your smart TV's browser, press Start on this TV, and run the night from your phone. The display fits any TV and works with the remote.
- [Auto-advance, a count-in, a song time limit and “let others go first”](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/auto-advance-count-in-and-song-time-limit) (2026-09-07): Let songs play one after another with a short break, count each singer in, cap songs at a set length, and let singers who aren't ready move their song back.
- [Add any song by pasting a YouTube link](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/add-a-song-by-pasting-a-youtube-link) (2026-08-12): Found the perfect karaoke version on YouTube? Paste its link into KaraoQ's search box to add it to the queue. Search results now show each video's length and views too.
- [See when it's your turn](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/karaoke-queue-wait-times) (2026-08-02): KaraoQ estimates when each song will play from song lengths and the breaks between singers, shows singers when they're up, and lets hosts set a wrap-up time.
- [Customize your screens, pick a theme, and take turns fairly](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/customize-your-karaoke-screen-and-fair-rotation) (2026-07-26): Edit the host and display layouts in place, choose Classic, Minimal or Neon, and turn on fair rotation so singers take turns instead of one person queuing five songs.
- [KaraoQ in 10 languages, plus sing-together posts and requests](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/karaoke-app-in-10-languages-with-duets) (2026-07-04): Use KaraoQ in English, Japanese, Filipino, Spanish, Korean, Portuguese, German, Indonesian, Czech or French, and find people in the room to sing a duet with.
- [Bring on a co-host](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/karaoke-co-host-from-your-phone) (2026-06-03): Share a co-host link or QR code and a friend can search for songs, manage the queue and skip ahead from their own phone without interrupting the song.
- [Cheers, a shared display and a printable join sign](https://www.karaoq.live/whats-new/karaoke-cheers-and-shared-display) (2026-05-07): Guests cheer the singer with emoji from their phones, the shared display shows the lyrics with a QR code to join, and hosts can print a join sign for the table.
